messages:
olivia_sales: Heads-up: Meridian POC needs signed order form + our DPA by EOD. They attached their PO template and asked for KMS attestation and a hard 30-day deletion SLA. Can legal/procurement triage?

sam_legal: Share the redline pls. 30 days is short; we usually push for 60-90 for backups. Also need to check their PO terms for indemnity/liability edits.

olivia_sales: Attached: Meridian_PO_Template.pdf. They added a PO field and default payment net45.

nina_procure: PO field fine. Finance prefers net30; net45 needs approval if < $100k. Is this POC likely to convert?

olivia_sales: Expected ARR ~120k if it goes well. I'll flag for finance.

sam_legal: Propose compromise: customer-visible data deletion 30 days, backups/archives 90 days. KMS attestation factual only, no added warranty. I'll draft redline.

ben_sre: For KMS: we can state tenant logical isolation and KMS provider details. We don't offer tenant HSMs in hosted plan; if they require that, escalate to Private deployment.

olivia_sales: Meridian prefers hosted. Ask them if the attestation language suffices before escalating.

sam_legal: Draft attestation I will include: "Redwood confirms keys are logically isolated per customer, managed by [Cloud KMS], and protected using industry-standard controls. This attestation is informational and does not expand contractual liability."

nina_procure: I'll prepare orderform with PO number, billing block, and payment terms set to net30 with a note allowing net45 subject to finance sign-off.

olivia_sales: OK I'll send the redline + orderform to Meridian and ask them to initial any changes. Also asked if provisional PO until finance issues final PO would work.

envelope-bot: DocuSign envelope created: "Redwood  Meridian POC Orderform" (env: abcd1234). Recipients: meridian_signer, olivia_sales.

meridian (via olivia_sales): They viewed the redline and accepted the 30/90 deletion split. Confirmed PO field required. Net45 preferred but they'll accept net30 for pilot. Asking for SOC2 report and subprocessor list.

ben_sre: We can share SOC2 redacted and current subprocessor list. Expect 2 business days turnaround for questionnaire.

envelope-bot: Envelope viewed by meridian_signer at 1761240032.

sam_legal: Great  if they initialled, we can finalize quickly. Remind them to initial the DPA redline to reduce back-and-forth.

nina_procure: Finance approved net45 for this deal size. I'll mark payment terms net45 and include invoice remit fields.

olivia_sales: Sent final to Meridian for signature. Thanks team.

envelope-bot: Envelope completed at 1761240060. Signed orderform and DPA saved to deals/Meridian/2026/attachments.

olivia_sales: Signed  uploading to CRM and routing to finance for PO issuance. Nice quick turnaround, thanks all.
